answer.reason: The verses state that the kingdom of Babylon was given to the Medes and Persians, and that their law could not be changed.

clauses.english: received the kingdom of Babylon, divided and given to the Medes and Persians
clauses.quote: Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

clauses.english: had a law that altered not, so that a decree the king established could not be changed
clauses.quote: no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

doubts: EZR 6:2 names the province of the Medes only as the place where the roll was found, so it was left out.
The kingdom given to the Medes and Persians is spoken of together with the Persians, not the Medes alone.
